meta.description: ATAC-seq library quality control: TSS enrichment, FRiP, fragment-size periodicity, library complexity (NRF/PBC1/PBC2), mitochondrial fraction, and ENCODE 4 thresholds.

scientific_integrity.detail: Thresholds labeled ENCODE vs working convention; no fabricated values

methodological_ground.detail: NRF/PBC computed on fragments and matches an independent counter

code_usability.detail: All four scripts ran on numpy 2.5, pandas 3.0, deepTools 4.0

functional_suitability.note: Seven metrics covered; scripts now deliver documented filters, periodicity class and per-sample MultiQC table; mt fraction only exercised on synthetic data

reliability.note: Empty/absent/invalid inputs fail loudly with counts; residual: out-of-coverage TSS slowness, mate MAPQ not inspected (documented)

agent_usability.note: Explicit script args, bigWig recipe and preseq -P; BED6 contract stated

human_usability.note: Prompts and tips; still no worked sample-level example

security.note: Read-only file access, no credentials or destructive ops

maintainability.note: Small documented scripts; thresholds sourced to ENCODE vs convention; no shipped tests

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, version-drift guidance, provenance; claims now match execution

inputs.label: ENCODE-style TSS enrichment: real GM12878 slice plus planted bigWig
inputs.note: Real 11.381 vs deepTools 11.391; planted 21.0 for plus, minus, gene-interval and multi-chrom cases

assertions.text: Real-slice score agrees with independent deepTools profile
assertions.note: 11.381 (1,373 TSS used) vs 11.391 from the earlier deepTools matrix

assertions.text: Planted bigWig returns 21.0 for plus, minus and chr2 TSS
Gene-interval BED6 uses start for plus and end-1 for minus
assertions.note: 21.0 after correcting my own fixture (first attempt gave 11.0 because my plus-strand gene start was 1 kb off the planted TSS; t_tss_gene2.log)

assertions.text: Absent chromosome, empty BED and BED3 fail loudly with exit 1
assertions.note: exit 1 each with used/skipped counts or BED6 message

assertions.text: Mixed valid/absent/edge rows report used and skipped counts

inputs.label: NRF/PBC1/PBC2 on real unfiltered and filtered BAM plus planted PE/SE
inputs.note: Real 0.778/0.798/5.074 equals independent counter; planted truth 250/160/0.64/0.625/2.0 in PE and SE

assertions.text: Real unfiltered BAM equals independent fragment counter
Planted PE and SE reproduce hand-computed truth after MAPQ and chrM filters
Deduplicated BAM triggers warning and PBC2 null
Output is strict JSON and empty result exits 1
MT/M contig names are excluded
assertions.note: BAM renamed 1/MT gives 250 (excluded 600); with exclusion off 550

inputs.label: atac_qc_metrics.R: real filtered slice with IDR .bed.gz peaks, planted BAM, hg19 TxDb argument, seqlevel mismatch
inputs.note: Real rep1 TSSEscore 23.54, NFR+mono, FRiP 0.671; planted 250 nuclear pairs; mismatch stops

assertions.text: Real slice metrics reproduce and periodicity class is NFR+mono
Planted BAM nuclear pairs equal 250 after chrM, MAPQ and dup exclusion
Non-default TxDb argument is honored
assertions.note: hg19 TxDb ran (TSSEscore 1.29 vs 5.13 hg38 on same reads); real non-hg38 data not available

assertions.text: BAM/TxDb seqlevel mismatch stops with message
Fragment-size PDF is legible
assertions.note: 1-page 15.5 KB PDF written; no renderer available, so not visually inspected

inputs.label: aggregate_qc.py multi-sample and flat input, MultiQC hand-off
inputs.note: Grades PASS/WARN/FAIL/INCOMPLETE correct for 5 samples; MultiQC parsed table

assertions.text: Per-metric and overall grades match threshold table incl inverted mt_fraction
assertions.note: A PASS, B WARN, C FAIL, D INCOMPLETE

assertions.text: null and absent metrics grade NA, not PASS
Non-numeric and boolean values exit 2
Extra keys noted on stderr
MultiQC 1.35 ingests the *_mqc.tsv as a sample table

inputs.label: samtools/Picard/deepTools/MultiQC recipes on real slice
inputs.note: flagstat, Picard median 191, Spearman 0.9577, fingerprint curves, MultiQC modules detected

assertions.text: flagstat/idxstats report expected counts
assertions.note: 1,048,048 mapped; synthetic idxstats chrM 600/1260 = 0.476 (labeled synthetic; slice has no chrM)

assertions.text: Picard insert size metrics are plausible
Spearman heatmap and matrix are consistent
assertions.note: 0.9577; heatmap rendered and labeled (2x2, no cell annotation)

assertions.text: Fingerprint curves render and diverge from diagonal
MultiQC detects Picard, samtools, deepTools and preseq outputs

inputs.label: preseq c_curve/lc_extrap recipes with -P on coordinate-sorted unfiltered BAM
inputs.note: c_curve -P -s 1e5 gives 10 rows to 0.9M; lc_extrap -P monotone with ordered CI

assertions.text: c_curve -P -s 1e5 returns a multi-row curve
lc_extrap -P is monotone with ordered CI
Extrapolated counts are consistent with observed curve
assertions.note: 608,697 expected at 1M vs observed c_curve trend

assertions.text: Documented lc_extrap -e 200M -s 5M literal command was run
assertions.note: run at reduced -e 20M -s 1M for time; literal values not re-executed here

assertions.text: Step guidance yields non-header-only output
assertions.note: -s 1e5 gives rows; header-only for -s 1e6 reproduced only by the fixer

inputs.label: Silent-failure guards across scripts
inputs.note: Planted probes for TSS, complexity, aggregation and R stop or grade correctly

assertions.text: TSS script cannot report success with zero scored TSS
Complexity script cannot report success with no reads
aggregate_qc never grades missing data PASS
R script stops on genome-build seqlevel mismatch
aggregate_qc rejects non-numeric input rather than coercing

key_strengths: All ten prior findings reproduced as fixed against real GM12878 data and planted truth
Fragment-level NRF/PBC matches an independent counter exactly on 601,203 fragments
Silent-success paths in TSS, complexity and aggregation scripts now exit non-zero or grade NA
Thresholds separate ENCODE-sourced values from working convention
